review_notes: I read the whole file. It introduces no new definition, structure or class. It has three local notations (𝓕, Γₘ, res[ ]), two private lemmas and one instance, `isFlasque_tilde_of_injective`, which states `(tilde M).presheaf.IsFlasque`. That instance uses Mathlib's own `IsFlasque`, `tilde`, `modulesSpecToSheaf` and `TopCat.Presheaf.restrict_restrict`. The local notations are thin abbreviations over Mathlib's presheaf and `Prefunctor.map`, not a competing concept. `Ideal.primaryComponent` and `IsLocalizedModule.Away` come from other TauCeti files. They are not defined here, so I did not assess them. I did not check whether Mathlib already has equivalents. No finding fits this rubric, which excludes theorem duplication and proof shortening. The ad hoc argument that an open set is a finite union of basic opens is a proof step, not a competing concept.
